name: CyberCat
brief: Preserve purple bob hair, cyan streaks, violet eyes, cat ears, headphones, halo and purple cyber clothing. Extend the brand bust into a tiny full-body chibi. Use cute blinking, waving, hopping, hopeful waiting, focused work and expressive reactions; no new props or text. Generate coherent state strips and clockwise gaze rows from the same canonical reference.
processing: Bundled work-pets 0.1.6 extraction, inspection, atlas composition, look registration, one chroma despill, structural validation and quality checks. Shared transform per animation state preserves original jump displacement.
